su-shi.oneLineEn: Northern Song literatus spanning the Three Teachings; known for classics, statecraft, and life-writing.

sunzi.oneLineEn: Central figure of the military tradition tied to The Art of War.

symeon-the-new-theologian.oneLineEn: Byzantine mystic whose divine-light experience and spiritual knowledge shaped later hesychasm.

tang-zhen.oneLineEn: Early Qing thinker who, in Hidden Book, criticized monarchical power and social injustice.

tao-hongjing.oneLineEn: Southern Dynasties Shangqing Daoist master, also physician, recluse, and scripture editor.
keywordsEn: Collected Commentaries on the Materia Medica

tran-nhan-tong.oneLineEn: Trần emperor-Zen master who founded Trúc Lâm, uniting Vietnamese Zen lines and a poetic tradition.
keywordsEn: Fu on Dwelling in Dust and Delighting in the Way

tran-thai-tong.oneLineEn: Trần emperor-Zen master whose Lessons on Emptiness grounded medieval Vietnamese Zen.

vladimir-solovyov.oneLineEn: Hub of Russian religious philosophy; all-unity, Godmanhood, sophiology, and the Good shaped the Silver Age.

wang-chong.oneLineEn: Eastern Han thinker who, in Balanced Discourses, attacked omen lore and empty doctrines.

wang-gen.oneLineEn: Ming Taizhou founder; held that the Way is the people's daily use and sought self-settling via gewu.
keywordsEn: the Way is the people's daily use
investigating things to settle the self

wang-tingxiang.oneLineEn: Ming qi monist who used experience-oriented qi monism against empty mind learning.

wei-yuan.oneLineEn: Late Qing statecraft thinker; Maritime Kingdoms urged learning barbarian skills to control barbarians.
keywordsEn: Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms

xu-heng.oneLineEn: Early Yuan Neo-Confucian educator who brought Cheng-Zhu learning into Yuan institutions.
keywordsEn: Direct Explanations of the Elementary Learning and Great Learning

xuanzang.oneLineEn: Tang monk, translator, and traveler who founded Chinese Faxiang Yogācāra.
keywordsEn: Great Tang Records on the Western Regions

yan-yuan-qing.oneLineEn: Early Qing practical-learning leader urging solid writing, practice, and use against empty Neo-Confucianism.

yanshou.oneLineEn: Five Dynasties–Song master who joined Chan teaching with myriad-good return in the Source-Mirror.
keywordsEn: Collection on the Common Return of Myriad Goods

ye-shi.oneLineEn: Southern Song Yongjia figure known for institutions, utility, and critique in intellectual history.
keywordsEn: Sequential Record of Learning and Words

zhan-ruoshui.oneLineEn: Ming Ganquan school leader who taught as a peer and rival of Wang Yangming.

zhang-shi.oneLineEn: Southern Song Neo-Confucian of the Huxiang school who long debated with Zhu Xi.

zhang-xuecheng.oneLineEn: Qing history theorist known for 'the Six Classics are all history' and collation theory.
keywordsEn: General Meaning of Literature and History
the Six Classics are all history
